races.verdict: MISS MONA KEEBA shaped very well when second of 21 over C&D on debut a fortnight ago, travelling best before perhaps going on too soon, and with improvement expected she is fancied to go one better. Tequila Belle is feared most after finishing a couple of places behind her that day and Villaray also respected despite the trip possibly being on the sharp side. MISS MONA KEEBA (IRE) TEQUILA BELLE (IRE) VILLARAY (IRE)

races.display_title: Unibet Interactive 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: The well-related WOOTTON KING produced a very promising first effort when second in a C&D maiden 3 weeks ago, showing greenness before doing his best work at the finish. In leading hands and rating a sure-fire improver, he can go one place better here. Andrew Balding saddles a pair of interesting newcomers in the shape of Chariots of Fire and Bayside Waltz and the betting can likely decipher their chances. WOOTTON KING CHARIOTS OF FIRE (IRE) BAYSIDE WALTZ (IRE)

races.display_title: Try Unibet's Superboosts/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DADDY STAR showed plenty of ability when finishing runner up on debut in a Yarmouth maiden (7f) 5 weeks ago, making her effort on the opposite flank to the winner and finishing nicely clear of the rest. She's the type to build on that effort and holds sound claims from a handy draw. Out Late may emerge as the lead danger, with Stilton a newcomer to note from the Hugo Palmer stable. DADDY STAR (IRE) OUT LATE (IRE) STILTON

LADY'S GRACE WANNABE PERFECT WEATHERINGWITHYOU

races.verdict: A competitive nursery with the narrow vote in favour of GREAT OAK . A winner of a match race on debut at Ayr, he had viable excuses for a below-par showing at Haydock next time and he surely remains capable of better now handicapping from what looks a workable opening mark. Horndean on his first crack at 7f, Babzini and Somers Isles are others to consider, along with Tansy Lane . GREAT OAK (IRE) HORNDEAN (FR) BABZINI (IRE)
